intent: metadata for automatic post-push validation and release
note: Every completed push to main automatically validates and publishes a new unreleased manifest/request version only if all checks pass and the commit is still current.
changes: Introduce opt-in per-room bounded supervisory PID control for explicitly selected climate.* thermostats in heat/cool mode
Use pure derivative-on-measurement PID math, conditional integral anti-windup, safe sample intervals and conservative setpoint rate limits
Never toggle compressors or HVAC modes; issue only climate.set_temperature to configured same-room entities
Pause and persist manual thermostat overrides, service failures and explicit user pause, with manual resume/reset actions
Stop commands for open/unknown windows, stale temperature sensors, conflicting targets, unsupported modes and invalid temperature steps
Add optional multi-page PID configuration with safe defaults, user-facing diagnostics and pause/resume buttons to the existing card
Preserve all monitoring, international science, Home Assistant entities, domain, and Announcement Hub routing
Expand regression tests, documentation and translations; validate Python, card, Hassfest, HACS and release only after checks pass
